notes:
A panel can now also be reached at a pages.dev address. Cloudflare filters workers.dev and pages.dev separately in Iran, so a panel on only one of them is a single filtering decision away from being unreachable. Same build, same database, same login and users: one panel with two doors. In 4.9.0 this needs manual setup and has no panel control yet: you create the Pages project, bind it to the panel's own D1 and KV, and set PAGES_PROJECT on the Worker. A setting for it comes in the next release. The guards around it already work: the door is published only after the Worker copy is healthy, and is refused unless it is bound to this panel's own storage.

The Google AI route now requires a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy of your own and says so before you switch it on. A ProxyIP cannot carry it, because a ProxyIP forwards only to Cloudflare's edge, so the Google hosts never arrived and the request fell back to a direct connection from a Cloudflare address, which Google refuses. The switch made no difference at all, on or off.

Two measured contrast failures are fixed, the worst of them white text on bright cyan on the install and login buttons in dark mode.
